zoe: Heads-up: short creative sprint for the site hero and a matching launch post. Goal: drive webinar signups and demo requests. Targets: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private. Need 3 hero lines + CTAs by EOD.
mike: I can sketch headlines. Thinking concise contrasts: "Fastest way to ship LLM features" (hosted), "Reserved throughput, predictable latency" (dedicated), "Bring inference behind your VPC" (private). CTA pair: [Join webinar] / [Request demo].
anya: I'll turn those into 12-word microcopy variants and 6 social captions (X + LinkedIn + email subject). Keep hero stat-free; reserve the benchmark figure for the webinar.
rdg-bot: Reminder: webinar scheduled 11/10 10:00 PT "Inference Benchmarks & Best Practices". Register: https://cal.example.com/r/ri-webinar-1110
ops-sarah: Quick Ops ask: standardize a small lead payload so Sales gets variant + intent. Example: email, source=web_hero, variant, interest, ts. Add header X-Route for immediate routing.
zoe: Nice. Mike, please include 'burst capacity' on the Dedicated line and 'KMS' on the Private blurb. Anya, draft social posts that tease the 3x benchmark without a numeric hero claim.
mike: On it. I'll post three hero options and the CTA URLs here when ready. :rocket:
anya: Deliverables: 3 hero microcopy files, 6 social snippets, landing paragraph for webinar page. I'll ping product/research for sign-off on benchmark wording before publish.
zoe: Thanks team — compile drafts into Figma and drop link here when done.
